# Bundled facility assets

These are unchanged, byte-for-byte copies of the previously reviewed facility models and HDR environment. They are included to eliminate model-provider network access during ordinary development and build. Original source URLs, lengths and SHA-256 hashes remain in the five source locks in assets/. The staging script selects the exact required entries.

Sources: Tevy (scifi hangar, straight corridor, bridge, server room, reactor room, corridor door, button panel, cable bundle, rooftop cable tray, cleanroom airlock, lab drawer bench), Grab3D (quantum computer), Poly Haven (hangar interior HDRI). The project acquisition records document CC0-1.0 licensing; see docs/asset-first-composition.md, assets/refinement-lock.json, assets/spatial-transition-lock.json and assets/external-lock.json. CC0 terms: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Original URLs are retained for credit and reproducibility; this does not apply to unrelated code or assets. Do not commit unrelated auditions, generated models, node_modules, or cache.

The one-time acquisition run 45871114963 verified every original length and SHA-256, materialized 21 files (7,571,663 bytes) and restored all 21 from the bundle with empty generated/cache directories. Binary commit 6d0f095324188cb5f8b460dc04bb95ba57f327c3. Ordinary builds do not require upstream network access.
